title: Wozair
description: Wozair specializes in the design, manufacture, and installation of heavy-duty heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (HVAC) products for various sectors including Marine, Naval, Military, Nuclear, Oil and Gas, Powergen, and Renewables. Their product range includes air handling units, dampers, filtration solutions, and refrigeration systems. Wozair also offers services such as system design, project management, manufacturing, commissioning, and maintenance. The company aims to provide bespoke solutions to meet specific client requirements while ensuring a safe working environment.
